name: Microsoft Teams
description: Post task events from this project to a Microsoft Teams channel using a Workflows incoming webhook.

settings.label: Workflows webhook URL
settings.description: In Teams, use Workflows → “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”, then paste the HTTP POST URL here.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Choose which task events should post to this channel.

settings.label: Only notify when status changes (for task.updated)
settings.description: When enabled, task.updated is skipped unless the kanban or list status actually changed.
